positive_snippets: The resort is located in clean and green surroundings.  It is very safe and easily located. The room is good and spacious but with aura of 80s..to my taste.  The breakfast menu is very elaborate and the cleanliness is superb. The staff is polite and courteous.   It is a very good option for stay to receive or see off loved ones at IGI. A lot of foreigners and Indians from South stayed there.

Wonderful stay and excellent service

I had a really pleasant stay at this resort. The rooms were spacious, clean, and very well maintained — comfortable enough to truly relax and unwind. Housekeeping was prompt and everything was taken care of nicely.

The breakfast service deserves a special mention. There was a good variety of options, the food was fresh, tasty, and well presented, and the staff was courteous and attentive throughout.

Overall, the ambience of the resort is peaceful and well thought out, making it a great place to stay whether you’re here for leisure or a short getaway.

I’d especially like to appreciate , Omkar, for his professionalism, politeness, and helpful nature. He ensured that everything went smoothly and made the stay even more comfortable.
negative_snippets:
I stayed here for a meeting at the Yashobhoomi Convention Centre, and the location is definitely the highlight. It sits perfectly between the convention centre and Indira Gandhi International Airport (Kapashera area), making it very convenient for business travelers.
The Positives:
Peaceful Atmosphere: Unlike most hotels near the highway, this resort is tucked away. There is almost no noise from traffic or horns, which ensures a very good night's sleep.
Spacious Property: The resort has big lawns and a lot of open space. The rooms are older but quite large compared to newer boutique hotels.
Budget-Friendly Stay: At around ₹5,500, it is a decent 4-star budget option for the area.
The Not-so-Positives:
Service Levels: Don't expect "star-level" service here. The staff is okay, but the service isn't quite up to the mark for a 4-star establishment.
Expensive Dining: The food is average, but the prices are very high. Be careful with the menu—for example, a single bottle of water was charged at ₹89. I’d recommend checking the prices before ordering.
Pool: There is a swimming pool in the lawn, but it is quite small and shallow.
Final Verdict: If you need a quiet, spacious place to sleep near Yashobhoomi or the airport without the highway noise, this is a solid choice. Just keep your expectations realistic regarding the service and food costs.
